_derivation: The tenth mode, outside the matrix and NOT record-friendly. 1280x720, MCS band 0-5 (the full link envelope), fps free to float 30-100 via the §9.11 ladder (Pass 39/99). It spans the whole envelope because it trades cadence for rung all the way down: as the selector drops the MCS and the derived bitrate, P-frames shrink and the ladder lowers fps to keep each frame's FEC block useful. bpp is self-correcting — at MCS0 (2829 kbps) the ladder settles low fps so bpp stays well above the 0.04 floor. video0.fps below is only the boot seed; the ladder owns it once running.
_apply: fps_mode=variable makes apply-mode.sh turn the §9.11 ladder ON (live, via POST /api/v1/link/fps) AFTER the venc restart, and persist venc.fps_ladder.enabled=true so a reboot boots variable. The ladder span (min 30 / preferred 100) is a per-craft constant in craft.json (venc.fps_ladder). VFR + GDR intra-refresh => live-view only, do not record.
